stem: Urvashi cuts $8$ identical ribbon pieces. Each piece has length $0.35\,\mathrm{m}$.

parts.text: Which calculation finds the total length of ribbon?

options.text: Write the total as the word rate, and stop.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Eight equal lengths of 0.35 m are found by multiplying 8 × 0.35.

teacher.key_rationale: Equal groups of a decimal length use multiplication: 8×0.35. A substitutes a label. B reverses to division. D adds once instead of repeating the group.
